parsed.answer: I couldn't find a past ticket reporting this exact problem, a multi-second freeze of the whole Terminal window each time the input language is switched (Win+Space / Alt+Shift) with many tabs open. The retrieved tickets are about different problems. Some are general freezes: terminal#19333 (render freeze, fixed in Canary or by a GPU driver/Windows update), terminal#11903 and terminal#9306. Others are input-method issues: terminal#18691 (IME forced to Microsoft Pinyin after Alt+Tab) and terminal#18713 (freeze with the WeType IME installed). None of them describes a freeze triggered by switching input language that grows with tab count. Please file this as a new issue with the details you gave. A controlled bisection of freeze duration against tab count and a WPR/ETW trace taken during a language switch would help the team. It would also help to check whether the freeze occurs with only a few tabs open, and whether it reproduces on the Canary build.
